candidate_bindings: External finite iterator of explicit partial or full typed environments. Known first-order pattern equations jointly infer missing bindings. No default source environment, variable/eigen guess or formula enumeration. Bad candidate DescriptorError becomes per-binding code/reason like old match; iterator/callback errors propagate.
completion: Validate each supplied value exactly as original infer; all repeated observed parameter equations reach fixed point.
Require EVERY declared parameter including BOUND/EIGEN/internal-only VARIABLE/PREDICATE_SYMBOL/FORMULA/TERM. _binding enforces full types, abstraction arities and free-external allowances.
Reset renamings, forward instantiate every root hypothesis/input/output using unchanged capture-safe routine and compare every observed formula literally; syntax-check every resulting formula.
Reset conditions and formula-only root_inputs, check root declared distinct/eigen/side conditions against complete original Gamma and ALL required root input formulas, including derived obligations.

No core.expand, primitive body expansion, nested-frame side-condition check, native membership, physical source or point union occurs. Existing complete expansion/checker/native stage remains mandatory.
errors: External native/callback exceptions wrapped by original _Work and rethrown identically, never counted as negatives. Own work/depth produces UNKNOWN/prefix; observation/registry malformed data outside binding loop propagates DescriptorError. Root supplied synchronous tick/Source guard scope unchanged.
generic_hidden_binder_edge: An observed FORMULA-meta may absorb a complete all-tree and bind F0 without constraining a separate declared binder ID used only inside a body axiom. Emptyenv then yields UNBOUND_UNKNOWN containing that binder ID. It succeeds only when the external finite candidate prefix explicitly supplies a valid value or another actual observed equation determines it; no source-binder fallback.
limits: Original _Work/DEFAULT_LIMITS unchanged: work200000/depth64/expanded_nodes4096/binding_attempts64/results16, reductions only; one cumulative work/tick across registry, observations, attempts, projection and output. expanded_nodes cap unused by new projection because no DAG is expanded. Complete earlier records may remain in a bounded prefix; never infer exhaustion.

observed_receptors.authority: All registry/host/observation syntax is untrusted. The endpoint cannot authenticate that an output came from BRANCH or that an input mark physically exists.
observed_receptors.hypotheses: Complete ordered descriptor list, each exact {port_id,gamma_index,formula}; formula must literally equal actual original host.ordered_Gamma[gamma_index]. Repeated context occurrence is allowed where descriptor permits; no new premise fact/physical row.
observed_receptors.inputs: Ordered duplicate-free descriptor subset, exact {port_id,formula}; no source/row/occupied/fact fields accepted. Zero observed inputs allowed.
observed_receptors.outputs: Nonempty ordered duplicate-free descriptor subset, exact {port_id,formula}. Descriptor IDs/order and all native AST syntax checked before consuming candidate iterator, even if empty.

old_public_APIs: validate_registry/expand_family/match_family and every inherited helper/class/nested body raw+AST unchanged, including VERSION. New API uses distinct prefix/proposal schema IDs plus implementation_version; exact Source pin distinguishes implementation.

prefix_wire.flags: Exact inherited FLAGS; syntax-only proposal true, all native/proof/point/activation/pruning/RL/runtime authority false.
prefix_wire.rejections: binding_index/code/reason/missing_parameters; UNBOUND_UNKNOWN explicitly lists residual IDs. Definite invalid candidate is not logical no-family/no-tiling evidence.
prefix_wire.request: Full copied registry/family_id/host/observed_receptors after complete observation validation, otherwise null on own setup bound. Candidate iterator itself is not serialized.
prefix_wire.status: PROPOSALS iff any complete record else UNKNOWN

proposal_wire.request: Full registry/family_id/host/observed subset/initial_binding; binding_index labels external prefix entry.
proposal_wire.required_port_formulas: All ordered hypotheses/inputs/outputs, each {port_id,formula,basis}, hypotheses additionally gamma_index. basis ORIGINAL_GAMMA_OCCURRENCE, OBSERVED_FORMULA_CONSTRAINT, DERIVED_CONDITIONAL_OBLIGATION or DERIVED_OUTPUT_FORMULA. No operative physical fields.
proposal_wire.scope: Observed/derived labels are syntax provenance only, not premise truth or physical occupancy. Full request may retain opaque user provenance, never authenticate it.
proposal_wire.substitution: Complete ground native typed environment only
